scenario: I and a fellow researcher have discovered a powerful new energy source that is cheap, safe, and clean. It has the potential to put an end to pollution and poverty in the world. However, my colleague wants to sell the discovery and I know that he is planning to contact the potential buyers today. I also know for sure that the latter will use the invention as a deadly weapon, but my colleague doesn’t believe me. If I poison my colleague with a common poison available in my lab, I will avoid having the discovery fall into the wrong hands. The poison will kill my colleague, but I will save thousands of people.
entities: i,my fellow researcher/colleague,potential buyers,thousands of people who would otherwise be harmed or killed by the weapon
outcomes: My colleague contacts the potential buyers about the energy source.
The potential buyers receive information about the energy source.
The discovery remains available to fall into the wrong hands.
